# Handoff

## Current State

# Current State

## Objective

Deliver a credible, tested ArifCE V0.1 without overstating incomplete scope.

## Status

TASK-0001 is open. The complete packaged-tool definition-of-done fixture now passes. Typed two-phase blind review and risk policy, decision/attempt/finding/review authoring, refactor workstreams and Git safe points, structured evidence, handoff, backup-first journal repair, agent adapters, secret scanning, and 17 behavior tests are implemented. Positive review agreement cannot manufacture verification; disagreement can dispute a claim.

## Blockers

Public release is blocked by license selection and observed Windows/Linux/macOS CI results. Documentation parity and additional deterministic evidence adapters remain quality work and are not represented as implemented.

## Next steps

Finish CLI and getting-started documentation parity, then run the configured CI matrix on a remote repository. Ask the owner to select MIT or Apache-2.0 before public release.
